user.title: Connect to your SIEGENIA door
user.description: Enter the address of your door and the credentials of a user account configured on it.

data_description.host: The IP address or hostname of the door on your local network.
data_description.username: A user account configured on the door. Use a dedicated account: the door allows only one session per account, so sharing one with the SIEGENIA app makes the two disconnect each other.
data_description.port: Leave at 443 unless you have changed it.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with your SIEGENIA door
reauth_confirm.description: The door at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure your SIEGENIA door
reconfigure.description: Update how Home Assistant reaches this door.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Check that the address is correct and that the door is reachable on your network.
error.session_occupied: Another client is already signed in with this account. Close the SIEGENIA app, or set up a dedicated account on the door for Home Assistant.
error.wrong_device_type: This is a SIEGENIA {device_type}, not an automatic door. This integration only supports the ACS door family.

abort.already_configured: This door is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The address entered points at a different door than the one this entry was set up for.

init.title: Door users
init.description: Add a user to the door, or manage one that already exists. Everything here is stored on the door itself and takes effect immediately.

add_user.title: Add a door user
add_user.description: The new account is created on the door. Its fingerprints, tags and codes are enrolled afterwards, from the menu of the user you just created.

data_description.username: The name the door will show for this user.
data_description.password: The password for the new account, needed to sign in with the SIEGENIA app. The door never reports it back, so keep your own record of it.
data_description.usertype: "User" is the ordinary choice. "Admin" grants full control of the door, including its users.

select_user.title: Select a door user
select_user.description: Pick the user you want to manage.

enroll_fingerprint.title: Add a fingerprint for {username}
enroll_fingerprint.description: Only fingerprint slots that are still free for {username} are listed. Go to the door before you continue: it starts waiting for a finger the moment you submit this form.

data_description.aptype: Which of the four fingerprint slots this user's new fingerprint is stored in.

remove_credential.title: Remove a credential from {username}
remove_credential.description: The credential is deleted from the door straight away and cannot be recovered; it has to be enrolled again.

delete_user.title: Delete {username}?
delete_user.description: This removes {username} from the door together with every fingerprint, tag and code enrolled against them. It cannot be undone.

progress.enrolling: Present the finger on the door's reader now, and follow the door's prompts until it confirms. This is {slot} for {username} and usually takes about twenty seconds. Closing this dialog cancels the enrollment.

error.create_user_failed: The door refused to create that user. Check that the name is not already in use and that the password meets the door's requirements.
error.slot_taken: That fingerprint slot was filled while this form was open. Pick another one.

abort.cannot_connect: Lost contact with the door before the change could be made. Nothing was changed.
abort.entry_not_loaded: This door is not connected right now, so its users cannot be managed. Reload the integration and try again.
abort.enrollment_already_running: The door is already enrolling a credential, started by the SIEGENIA app or another Home Assistant dialog. Finish or cancel that one first.
abort.enrollment_failed: The door ended the enrollment without storing a fingerprint. Nothing was added; try again and follow the door's prompts.
abort.enrollment_timeout: No fingerprint was presented in time, so the enrollment was cancelled at the door. Nothing was added.
abort.no_credentials: This user has no fingerprints, tags or codes enrolled.
abort.no_free_fingerprint_slots: This user already has all four fingerprint slots in use. Remove one before adding another.
abort.no_users: The door reports no users at all.
abort.unsupported_user_model: This door uses the newer user management commands, which this integration cannot drive safely. Manage its users with the SIEGENIA app instead.
abort.user_gone: That user no longer exists on the door.

daymode_unsupported.message: This door does not report day/night mode, so it cannot be locked or unlocked from Home Assistant. Firmware 1.11 and later removed this feature from the local interface. You can still use the open action.

open_failed.message: Failed to release the door latch: {error}
